symmetry_orbits_preserved.not_preserved: the orbits of the in-plane lattice reflections (generic orbits of 16 cells, 4 z copies of 4 in-plane images): each in-plane image draws its own transformation, so a surrogate still breaks the pairing of those images
symmetry_orbits_preserved.preserved: the z copies of a cell: cells whose 64 states agree bit for bit with those of the z = 0 cell above them take that cell's draws and surrogate values, for all three kinds

orbit_direct_relabeling.law: labels exchanged among whole orbits of equal size inside the pair; the area of each draw is the cell-level area of the actual scores

orbit_level_exclusions.rule: an orbit that holds both labels has no label at orbit level: it leaves the orbit counts, the orbit-level label null and the likelihood-ratio test, and a pair that loses one gets no P13d call

p13d_rule_applied.threshold_law: rank-sum law of the orbit counts

rng: ChaCha8, one stream per (use, run, cell or pair), seeded from the draw value through splitmix64

seeds.use: random unit triples of the property table
